description: Check the signed-in buyer's latest offer on a listing made with make_offer. Returns the offer's amount in USD, its status (for example pending, accepted, declined or expired) and expiry, plus agreed_price_usd: the price start_purchase will charge if the seller accepted, otherwise null. Returns offer: null if the buyer has made no offer on this listing. Requires a Port66 session.

id.description: The listing's id, exactly as returned in the `id` field of search_listings results (a slug such as 'kaws-x-sesame-street-water-parade-elmo-figure').

name: offer_status
title: Offer status
